sentences.text: Iron Man 3 -LRB- stylized onscreen as Iron Man Three -RRB- is a 2013 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character Iron Man , produced by Marvel Studios and distributed by Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures .	Iron Man	Iron Man (2008 film)	Marvel Studios	Marvel Studios	superhero film	superhero film	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures	Walt Disney Studios Motion Pictures

It is the sequel to 2008 's Iron Man and 2010 's Iron Man 2 , and the seventh film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe .	Iron Man	Iron Man (2008 film)	Iron Man 2	Iron Man 2	the seventh film	List of Marvel Cinematic Universe films	Marvel Cinematic Universe	Marvel Cinematic Universe

Shane Black directed a screenplay he co-wrote with Drew Pearce , which uses concepts from the `` Extremis '' story arc by Warren Ellis .	Shane Black	Shane Black	Drew Pearce	Drew Pearce	Extremis	Extremis	Warren Ellis	Warren Ellis

The film stars Robert Downey Jr. , Gwyneth Paltrow , Don Cheadle , Guy Pearce , Rebecca Hall , Stephanie Szostak , James Badge Dale , Jon Favreau , and Ben Kingsley .	Gwyneth Paltrow	Gwyneth Paltrow	Don Cheadle	Don Cheadle	Guy Pearce	Guy Pearce	Rebecca Hall	Rebecca Hall	Stephanie Szostak	Stephanie Szostak	James Badge Dale	James Badge Dale	Jon Favreau	Jon Favreau	Ben Kingsley	Ben Kingsley

In Iron Man 3 , Tony Stark deals with posttraumatic stress disorder caused by the events of The Avengers , while investigating the reemergence of the Ten Rings , led by the mysterious Mandarin and comes into a conflict with an old enemy : Aldrich Killian .	Iron Man	Iron Man (2008 film)	posttraumatic stress disorder	posttraumatic stress disorder	The Avengers	The Avengers (2012 film)	Mandarin	Mandarin (comics)	Aldrich Killian	Aldrich Killian

After the release of Iron Man 2 in May 2010 , Favreau , who served as director , decided not to return , and in February 2011 Black was hired to write and direct the film .	Iron Man	Iron Man (2008 film)	Iron Man 2	Iron Man 2
Black and Pearce opted to make the script more character-centric and focused on thriller elements .
Throughout April and May 2012 , the film 's supporting cast was filled out , with Kingsley , Pearce , and Hall brought in to portray key roles .
Filming began on May 23 , and lasted through December 17 , 2012 , primarily at EUE/Screen Gems Studios in Wilmington , North Carolina .	EUE/Screen Gems	EUE/Screen Gems	North Carolina	North Carolina

Additional shooting took place at various locations around North Carolina , as well as Florida , China , and Los Angeles .	North Carolina	North Carolina	Florida	Florida	China	China	Los Angeles	Los Angeles
The visual effects were handled by 17 companies , including Scanline VFX , Digital Domain , and Weta Digital .	Scanline VFX	Scanline VFX	Digital Domain	Digital Domain	Weta Digital	Weta Digital
The film was converted to 3D in post-production .
Iron Man 3 premiered at Le Grand Rex in Paris on April 14 , 2013 .	Iron Man	Iron Man (2008 film)	Le Grand Rex	Le Grand Rex
It began its release on April 25 , 2013 , internationally , and debuted in the United States one week later on May 3 .

The film received generally positive reviews and was commercially successful , grossing over $ 1.2 billion worldwide , the second highest-grossing film of 2013 overall , and the second-highest-grossing film at the domestic box office released in 2013 .	second highest-grossing film of 2013	2013 in film

It became the sixteenth film to gross over $ 1 billion and the 5th-highest-grossing film of all time , with its opening weekend ranking as the 6th-highest-grossing opening of all time .	5th-highest-grossing film of all time	List of highest-grossing films	6th-highest-grossing opening of all time	List of highest-grossing openings for films
